channelUrls.description: Public YouTube channel URLs, @handles, or UC… channel IDs. One row set is produced for each channel.
channelUrls.title: Channel URLs

includeLinks.description: In channel profile mode, include the external links shown on the public About page, with their titles and favicons.
includeLinks.title: Include public external links

includePlaylists.description: In channel profile mode, add a snapshot of the channel's public playlists, shows, courses, and podcasts to the same row. Use the playlists mode for one row per playlist.
includePlaylists.title: Nest playlists in the profile row

includePostComments.description: Collect public comments on each Community Post, up to the per-post limit. Adds one detail and one or more comment requests per post.
includePostComments.title: Include post comments

includePostDetails.description: Open each Community Post's public detail page to fill its exact ISO publish date and exact like count. Adds one request per post.
includePostDetails.title: Fetch exact post dates and likes

includePosts.description: In channel profile mode, add a snapshot of the channel's public Community Posts to the same row. Use the posts mode for one row per post.
includePosts.title: Nest Community Posts in the profile row

maxPlaylists.description: Maximum playlist, show, course, or podcast rows to collect per channel. Applies to the playlists mode and to nested profile snapshots.
maxPlaylists.title: Maximum playlists per channel

maxPostComments.description: Maximum public top-level comments to keep per Community Post when comments are included. Replies are not expanded.
maxPostComments.title: Maximum comments per post

maxPosts.description: Maximum Community Posts to collect per channel. Applies to the posts mode and to nested profile snapshots. YouTube exposes at most 200 posts per channel.
maxPosts.title: Maximum Community Posts per channel

mode.description: Channel profile returns one row per channel with its About details. Playlists returns one row per public playlist, show, course, or podcast. Posts returns one row per public Community Post.
mode.title: What to collect
